title: review-pull-request eval provider output
description: One review of one commit, as the Promptfoo provider returns it (eval/README.md). Extra fields are allowed: later asserts add their own (PMAT-302).

files_read.description: Repo-relative paths whose content the agent's model was shown; paths only, taken from the trace. Absent only if a file of the review has no span in the trace (reviewed before the trace existed).

trace.description: Path of the review's trace (PMAT-325): every tool call and its result as the model got them. Null when every changed file was excluded, so nothing was reviewed.
